newsitem.title: USA: Disney names Wong president of Imagineering.
newsitem.headline: Disney names Wong president of Imagineering.

text.p: Walt Disney Co said that Kenneth Wong will take over the helm of Walt Disney Imagineering, succeeding Peter Rummell.
Rummell has resigned to take the post of chairman and CEO of St. Joe Corp of Jacksonville, Fla., a large concern engaged in real estate and other business activities.

Wong, 40, will continue as president of WDI, and be responsible for management of the organization including creation and development of Disney's entertainment venues, including theme parks, retail stores, regional entertainment facilities and the master planning, development and asset management of Disney's real estate.
